1981-5147-6719.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
1981-5147-6719.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

339-574-677-5295.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
339-574-677-5295.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

4289-4770-6090-7060.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2137-3499-4642.description:
Cast Awaken the Woods with X equal to 3 by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands you control to their owner's hand, copying Awaken the Woods.
Resolve the copy of Awaken the Woods, creating three 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature tokens.
Activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.
2137-3499-4642.notes: Once you have infinite green mana and infinite land tokens, you may activate Uyo any number of times, targeting any number of instant or sorcery spells.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1395-5078-5434-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska and Elsha's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn
Resolve the Vraska trigger, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3490-5477-6968-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-5477-6968-7075.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

4247-4681-4730-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Sparring Mummy, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Sparring Mummy from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sparring Mummy enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

2557-6441-6763-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2511-7084-7889.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 6 or greater

81-215-539-7781.description:
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Cast Woodcaller Automaton for its prototype cost by paying {2}{G}{G}.
When Woodcaller Automaton enters, it triggers, untapping Kami of Whispered Hopes
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Woodcaller Automaton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

671-7690-7743--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
671-7690-7743--165.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-4302-5929.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2034-4302-5929.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Leyline of Transformation, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Ashnod's Altar ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

112-4668-7426.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least three cards this turn.
112-4668-7426.description:
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {U} due to Heliod, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Berta triggers, adding {U}.
Repeat.

348-2178-2577-7396.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Priest of Forgotten Gods.
Priest of Forgotten Gods does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one Zombie, and at least one additional creature except Gravecrawler or the Zombie.
348-2178-2577-7396.description:
Activate Priest of Forgotten Gods by tapping it and sacrificing Gravecrawler and any other creature.
When the creatures die, Priest of Forgotten Gods triggers twice, untapping itself.
Resolve the Priest of Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, and causing you to add {B}{B} and draw a card.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-5078-7356.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Harnfel by discarding a card, exiling the top two cards of your library and allowing you to cast them this turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Longshot triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Repeat.

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

1257-3259-5621--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
1257-3259-5621--85--106.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
Arid Archway enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-4013-5004-6643-7183.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cathodion, adding {C}{C}.
When Cathodion dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Edgar.
Cast Cathodion from your graveyard by paying {2}.
Repeat.

296-3532-3835-5078.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
296-3532-3835-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
The Thirteenth Doctor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3560-5147-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
3560-5147-5972.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1018-1987-2187-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1018-1987-2187-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Skullwinder and Possessed Skaab.
When Skullwinder and Possessed Skaab enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1018-1987-2187-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

3617-3982-5003.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Living Lore.
Living Lore does not have summoning sickness.
3617-3982-5003.description:
Deal combat damage to a player or permanent using Living Lore.
Living Lore triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Living Lore dies, its reflexive ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Living Lore trigger, causing you to cast Time Walk from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Living Lore from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
As Living Lore enters the battlefield, choose to exile Time Walk from your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.

1734-2150-2292.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes to the battlefield from exile.
When Hero of the Dunes enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

2232-4010-4231-4659.manaNeeded: {2}{G}{W} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2232-4010-4231-4659.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Farmer Cotton trigger, creating two 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and two Food, two Clue and two Treasure artifact tokens.
When the Halflings enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Farmer Cotton to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate the two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {G}{W}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Food or a Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Food and Clue tokens, you may sacrifice them to get infinite colorless mana, which can be used to cast Farmer Cotton for an arbitrarily large amount of mana to create infinite Treasure tokens.

3681-5076-5280.notablePrerequisites:
Grafted Exoskeleton attached to Kederekt Parasite.
You control a red permanent.
3681-5076-5280.description:
Cast Echo of Eons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing each player to shuffle their hand and graveyard into their library and draw seven cards.
Kederekt Parasite triggers for each card your opponent draw this way, giving each opponent seven poison counters.
Cast Echo of Eons from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to shuffle their hand and graveyard into their library, draw seven cards, and exile Echo of Eons.
Kederekt Parasite triggers for each card your opponent draw this way, giving each opponent seven poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

1978-2585-5159.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creaitng a token copy of Grim Monolith that is a 4/4 Construct artifact creature token with haste named Mishra's Warform in addition to its other types.
Activate Mishra's Warform by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Mishra's Warform.
Repeat from step 2.

1545-4050-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1} and either {W} or two life.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
The Soldier enters the battlefield, triggering Trostani, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion, causing it to enter the battlefield, triggering itself and Trostani.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Trostani trigger, causing you to gain two life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Spirit token, adding {1}.
Repeat.

742-3096.description:
Cast Demonic Consultation by paying {B}, naming Jace, Wielder of Mysteries and thus exiling your library due to you not having a card named Jace, Wielder of Mysteries in your library.
Activate Jace's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing target player to mill two cards and you to win the game due to drawing from an empty library.
